titulo: Ir, salir, venir + a + infinitive = to (purpose)
subtitulo: Salí a correr. Vengo a hablar con el gerente.
regla: With movement verbs (ir, salir, venir, bajar, subir, volver...) purpose can be expressed with a instead of para: Fui a su casa a hablar con él. Static verbs need para: Estoy aquí para verte. A que + subjunctive also works: Fui al doctor a que me revisara.

bloques.texto: After a **movement** verb, **a** = _to, in order to_, just like **para**: **fui a la tienda a comprar pan**.
**No movement, no a**: **estoy aquí para verte**, not ~~a verte~~.
With another subject: **a que** + subjunctive: **vine a que me firmaras esto**.
Tip: if you're walking somewhere, **a** can carry the purpose.

lista.es: Fui a su casa ==a hablar== con él.
lista.en: I went to his house to talk to him.
We went out to get some fresh air.
Javier isn't home; he went out for a run.

lista.es: ==Vengo a hablar== con el licenciado Ramírez. Tengo cita.
lista.en: I'm here to see Mr. Ramírez. I have an appointment.

lista.es: Tú nada más ==viniste a empeorar== las cosas.
lista.en: You only came to make things worse.

lista.es: Fui al doctor ==a que me revisara== la garganta.
lista.en: I went to the doctor to have my throat checked.

lista.texto: Careful: **voy a comer** can also be the future; context decides.

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _She went out to buy bread._
In Spanish: _I came to have you sign this._
lista.r: Vine a que me firmaras esto.
